common_keys_alt: Alt modifier. Windows and Linux spelling; macOS uses a glyph (Option).
common_keys_backspace: Key that deletes the character before the cursor.
common_keys_ctrl: Control modifier. Windows and Linux spelling; macOS uses a glyph.
common_keys_delete: Key that deletes the character after the cursor. writing-lint: allow pt-decalques-fracos: the key name as printed on the keyboard.
common_keys_enter: Key that confirms. Windows and Linux keyboards print Enter; macOS shortcuts use a glyph and never reach this message.
common_keys_escape: Key that cancels or closes. Printed on the keycap, so it is the same in every language.
common_keys_pagedown: Page Down key, as printed on keyboards.
common_keys_pageup: Page Up key, as printed on keyboards.
common_keys_shift: Shift modifier. Windows and Linux spelling; macOS uses a glyph.
common_keys_space: The space bar. Spelled out in pt-BR, where keyboards label it by the long bar.
